automationNotes: Doc order: Brand Kit from left navigation when present; if Brand Kit is missing from left nav, a verification warning is recorded and the flow opens Brand Kit via Organization dashboard product tile (see brandkit-dashboard-card DOM). Then New Brand Kit → modal (Brand Kit Name, Description optional, Select Stack(s), Create Brand Kit). Stack(s) must include DEFAULT_STACK from .env (same stack used later in CMS). Voice Profile: Communication Style Mixer sliders, Custom Details, Playground prompt + Generate (optional if AI busy). CMS + AI Assistant: entry editor → AI icon → verify Brand Kits / Voice Profiles / Knowledge Vault UI → select BK + VP → toggle Knowledge Vault → prompt + Enter → verify Accept / Try Again / Cancel → Accept → title → Save → Publish (Publish button only). Doc § Install AI Assistant from Marketplace defers to other docs — not automated here.
